授業概要
学生が取り組んでいる研究の進捗状況について、異なる研究を行っている学生や授業担当教員以外の教員に対して説明させる。研究の意義や内容および成果をわかりやすく伝えること，および，専門が異なる他の学生や多くの教員との議論を行うことを通じてコミュニケーション能力を高めるとともに、議論内容を自身の研究の進展に活用させる。
Students are required to explain the progress of their own research to other students who are engaged in different research topics and faculty members. This course is designed for students to improve their communication ability through clearly communicating and discussing significance, contents, and results of their research with other students and teaching staffs from different fields, which would be utilized for their own research progress.
